text:
maria_hr: Quick question — we have an employee starting adoption placement today. Can benefits be backdated to placement date and what docs do we need?

alex_benefits: Congrats to the family! Yes, most carriers allow retroactive enrollment to the placement date, usually up to 60 days. We need a placement letter from the agency or court documentation plus the adoption petition/court order when available.

sam_payroll: Heads up — for retro premiums we do an off-cycle adjustment once HR marks the dependent. Please include the placement date in the ticket so payroll can calculate owed/refund.

li_eng: If the SSN isn't issued yet, is coverage still allowed?

alex_benefits: Good Q. Carriers usually allow temporary coverage without SSN; mark SSN as TBD in the portal and upload placement docs. Once SSN arrives, update in the portal and we'll finalize enrollment.

maria_hr: Thanks. Is there a preferred file type for docs? I have a scanned agency letter.

alex_benefits: PDF is best. You can attach directly to the benefits portal under Dependents > Add dependent, or drop in the ticket.

benefits-bot: Ticket created: BR-4821 — Add dependent (adoption) for <employee>. Assigned to alex_benefits.

sam_payroll: Also note payroll cutoff for this pay period is TOMORROW 9am PT if you want premium changes reflected this cycle. Otherwise we'll include in next cycle but still do retro calculation.

maria_hr: I'll submit tonight and ping payroll. Do we need a coverage forms signature from the employee or is electronic portal consent sufficient?

alex_benefits: Electronic consent via portal is fine for carrier. If they prefer, employee can sign the paper form and upload it.

jordan_eng: Congrats!! :party_parrot: let me know if you want me to babysit the enrollment form — happy to help run through the portal with them.

maria_hr: Appreciate it, Jordan. I'll send the portal link and checklist. Will attach placement letter now and flag BR-4821 for payroll processing.

alex_benefits: One more note — if they want dental/vision added, those carriers follow similar rules but verify separate documents. I'll add a checklist item in the ticket.

benefits-bot: BR-4821 updated: checklist added (placement letter, court docs, SSN when available, dental/vision options).

sam_payroll: Once HR confirms effective date, payroll will post the off-cycle adjustment and confirm amount in the ticket.

maria_hr: Done — uploaded PDF placement letter and set dependent effective date = 2025-07-22. Marking this thread resolved for now; will reopen if anything missing.

alex_benefits: Got it. I'll process enrollment with the carrier and update BR-4821 when done. Thanks!
